title: Operating charter
description: The machine-readable half of the charter. CHARTER.md is the half a human reads; this is the half the controller enforces. The charter-builder skill produces both from one interview, and they must agree.

charter_version.description: Bump when any rule below changes. A bumped version requires renewed human acceptance.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of CHARTER.md at acceptance time. The controller recomputes this and refuses to run if the file changed without a new acceptance.

accepted.description: False until a human says yes. The orchestrator does no substantive work while this is false. This is the charter gate.

goals.description: What this person actually uses the system for. Personalize this.

prohibited.description: Actions never taken, with or without confirmation.

require_confirmation.description: Actions taken only after a human says yes, each time. Charter acceptance is NOT that yes.

definition_of_done.description: Observable conditions, not adjectives. 'Tests pass' is one; 'high quality' is not.

required_evidence.description: What must be shown before a claim counts as verified.

budgets.description: The controller enforces these. A budget the code does not check is a wish.

amendment_rule.description: How this charter may be changed, and by whom. A charter that the agent can rewrite is not a constraint.
